declare

 temp_product_code_desc VARCHAR2(256);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.unit_scheme := :scheme_type;
 IF NVL(length(:unit_add_on_bags.unit_id), 0) = 13 THEN
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 ELSE

 END IF; 
 IF :Unit_ADD_ON_BAGS.S_PRODUCT_CODE != 'M'

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 -- IF substr(:product_code,8,1) != '0' THEN /* Added By HCLC - Code128 */
 -- show_error('9713');
 -- check_package_failure;
 -- END IF;
 begin
 select components.product_code, product_desc
 into :product_code, :s_product_code_desc
 from components, valid_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 components.product_code = :product_code and
 reject_reason_code is null and
--HCLC components.product_code =
 substr(components.product_code,1,5) = --Modified By HCLC 
 valid_products.product_code and
 valid_products.unit_scheme_type = :scheme_type and --Modified By HCLC 
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and
 component_status = 'L';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 then
 select components.product_code, product_desc
 into :product_code, :s_product_code_desc
 from components, valid_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 components.product_code = :product_code and
 reject_reason_code is null and
--HCLC components.product_code =
 SUBSTR(components.product_code,1,5) = --Modified By HCLC 
 valid_products.product_code and
 valid_products.unit_scheme_type = :scheme_type and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and
 component_status = 'L' and rownum=1;
 
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
IF :scheme_type = 'C' THEN
 begin
 select component_prefix
 into :component_prefix
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 reject_reason_code is null and
 component_status = 'L';
 next_item;
 execute_trigger('key-next-item');
 -- next_field;
 exception
 when too_many_rows 
 then 
 :component_prefix:=null; 
 next_item;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
ELSE
 :unit_add_on_bags.component_prefix := SUBSTR(:unit_add_on_bags.product_code,7,2);
END IF;

end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :unit_add_on_bags.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :unit_add_on_bags.bags_used := 0;
 :unit_add_on_bags.segment_number := :ctrl_blk_3.segment_number;
 :unit_add_on_bags.segment_rem_flag := :ctrl_blk_3.segment_rem_flag;
 if :unit_add_on_bags.product_code is not null and
 :weld_flag = 'N'
 then
 begin
 select 'x'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :unit_add_on_bags.unit_id
 and product_code = :unit_add_on_bags.product_code
 and inter_code = 'WELD'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 begin
 insert into component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 product_code, inter_code, insert_dats,
 inter_user_id, audit_key, program_id)
 values
 (:unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :unit_add_on_bags.product_code, 'WELD', sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, audit_seq.nextval, :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in interdicting component');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if nvl(:unit_add_on_bags.number_of_bags,0) > 0
 then
 begin
 update units
 set add_on_bags = nvl(add_on_bags,0)+
 nvl(:unit_add_on_bags.number_of_bags,0),
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_current_rec VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure;
 temp_current_rec := :system.trigger_record;
 if :system.trigger_record = '1' and
 :number_of_items is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('unit_add_on_bags.s_product_code');
 else
 loop
 if :system.cursor_record = '1'
 then
 execute_trigger('key-down');
 exit;
 else
 up;
 end if;
 if :number_of_items is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('unit_add_on_bags.s_product_code');
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_current_rec varchar2(10);
 temp_number number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure;
 temp_number := :number_of_items;
 temp_current_rec := :system.trigger_record;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' and
 :number_of_items is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('unit_add_on_bags.s_product_code');
 else
 loop
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 if temp_current_rec = '1' and
 temp_number is not null
 then
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 else
 execute_trigger('key-up');
 end if;
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 if :number_of_items is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('unit_add_on_bags.s_product_code');
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end if;
end;
